Ive never done this, sorry if its not written the best, but I assure you these are kick ass burritos.

1 package yellow/saffron rice(or two, if you're using a fuck ton of hamburger like I do)(also this calls for butter or margarine or oil, whatever you wanna use, so have some of that shit handy)

1-2lbs of hamburger(or 3 if you you like these fuckers a lot, like I do)

1 can of black beans

1 can of chopped tomato with chillies(get a couple of real tomatoes too, just do it)

1 small can of salsa verde and/or jalapenos(get both if you're not poor as hell)

Couple chopped onions(red or yellow, none of that sweet shit though)

1lb of Whatever cheese you want(this isnt cheese class)

1-2 cans Enchilada sauce depending on how much hamburger you use(I use 2 cans for 3lbs and also I get the hot kind because its good)

Adobo with pepper and fajita seasoning(brand doesn't matter, just get some)

Package or 2 of Tortillas

small container of sour cream

1-2 tablespoons of Fresh chopped cilantro(if you use that dry shit in a bag ill come to your house and kick you square in the nuts and/or vagina)

Chopped olives(this is optional, sometimes I use them, sometimes I don't, depends on how my dicks swinging that day)

Get some Romain lettuce (or whatever kind if you're into that sort of thing, again its optional)

6 pack of your preferred beer(Not fucking optional, unless you're in recovery, in which case God speed, friend)

All right bitches, now lets cook. First and foremost, open a beer and get to drinking it. Then cook that damn rice, takes 20-30 fucking mins and the rest of this really doesn't, so get that shit going first. I shouldn't have to tell you how to cook it, its on the damn bag, if you can't read the bag then you have much larger problems than rice consumption, friend. Now is a good time to chop up that cilantro and lettuce/olives/real tomato if you got them. If you didn't get them, ignore this shit, get back to cooking, and have another beer. After you cook the rice, brown that hamburger, and drain it of grease. After, and I fucking mean AFTER you drain it, throw it back in the pan and put that adobo and fajita seasoning on it, as for how much, cover the top pretty liberally unless you're watching your blood pressure, in which case lighten up on it. Then, open your enchilada sauce and pour that in the beef with your salsa verde/jalepnos if you got that noise, mix it up and turn the heat down. Cook it down until its not soupy, depending on heat this might take a while, if you use a higher heat keep stirring it or itll burn, and while that doesn't ruin it at all, its a bitch to scrape off the bottom of the pan. Now's about time for another one of those beers.

While this bullshit is going on, open your black beans and wash em off, open the tomatoes and chilies(drain them pretty decently, you dont want soup in your burrito) throw those fuckers all in your rice and get to stirring, its a little work to get it all mixed into the rice. Then chop your onions(you can do this with the other veggies but I tend to wait until now because im not great at cooking), I like raw onions on my shit, feel free to cook yours with the beef if your weird ass so chooses to do so(fucking weirdo). Your soupy ass beef should be thicker and drier by now so throw that shit in your rice mixture, you may need a bigger bowl or pot for this as this ends up being quite a bit of food(hence the name, for the week). If its not dry enough, turn the heat up and get to stirring until its how you want it. At this point you have a choice to make, have another beer, or don't. But also put a bunch of cheese in now, or melt cheese over it later every time you want a burrito, I choose the latter as I feel adding the cheese into the meat while cooking somehow causes me to not taste it as well, and thus, fuck that. At this point, add your cilantro if you didn't pussy out on it, it really ties everything together, and that shit better be FRESH, because otherwise its not very good. Also, have another beer. You deserve it after this cluster fuck.

So now you have a bowl/pot of meat n rice bullshit and some chopped veggies, microwave a tortilla for like 10-15 seconds to make it easier to work with or if you want you can warm them in the oven for a lil bit while you cook if you turn it on the lowest setting and wrap them in foil or a damp towel.

Throw some of your meat n stuff on there, some sour cream if you got it and fold it over, fold in the ends and flip it, bam perfect burrito. Dont over fill it though or it gets hard to handle.

Now, you can either make all your burritos for the week now, or just make them whenever. I recommend whenever. Put your veggies in either one container or separately depending on how anal you are about your food touching. Just keep them separate from the meat n rice.
